execution_policy_status.reason: Model-quality gates remain diagnostic but no longer block the first complete engineering vertical slice; only integrity, leakage, numerical, interface and runtime defects hard-stop progression.

purpose: Reassess the largest current research gap from the authoritative repository state and completed evidence only, without using a preferred corruption, route, decoder or end-state schedule as the answer.

largest_scientific_gap.name: held-out-identifiable U-times-R-to-K-and-language bridge
largest_scientific_gap.statement: No released checkpoint or terminal experiment has shown, on independent held-out events, that changing only spatial U while visual evidence, route, ego state and shared contextual R are fixed produces the correct localized K and matched structured-language response.
largest_scientific_gap.why_primary: Without this bridge, a later conservative trajectory cannot be attributed to task-relevant interpretation of uncertainty rather than a foreground, route-template, corruption or universal-caution shortcut. A corruption-induced failure case alone cannot repair this attribution gap.

immediate_engineering_blocker.name: held-out conflict-actor relevance localization
immediate_engineering_blocker.statement: The current U-independent relevance path generalizes route/front structure substantially better than conflict-actor and non-front structure, so U cannot yet be exposed to a reliable shared R for a causal language test.

root_identifiability_limitation.name: independent event and component-view support
root_identifiability_limitation.statement: The frozen bank is too sparse and asymmetric to separate architecture failure from event/view coverage or template shortcuts, especially for conflict actors outside the front view.

parallel_foundational_gap.name: learned Stage-1 U external validity
parallel_foundational_gap.statement: The tokenizer passed representation reconstruction, but the spatial adapter remains a diagnostic evidence-loss proxy and missed its preregistered heavy-native-fog patch-AUROC gate.
parallel_foundational_gap.interpretation: This is independent of the contextual-R repair. Controlled or oracle U may diagnose the Stage2-L bridge, but learned-U claims remain blocked until a genuinely held-out native or sensor-family gate passes.

largest_final_claim_gap.name: no learned-U Stage2-P closed-loop result
largest_final_claim_gap.statement: Stage2-P has not started and no current-mainline checkpoint establishes collision, TTC, traffic-rule, completion or unnecessary-slowing benefit.
largest_final_claim_gap.current_failure_induction_evidence: five valid negative pairs and zero positive corruption-induced failure pairs
largest_final_claim_gap.interpretation: This is the largest distance to the final paper claim, but it is downstream of the causal semantic bridge rather than the next mechanism to optimize.

if_factorized_r_engineering_gates_pass: record factorization only as an engineering repair candidate
do not start language, Stage2-P or closed loop from the 17-event smoke
repair independent actor/component-view coverage under a separately frozen outcome-blind protocol
then preregister the matched controlled-U semantic bridge with shared R fixed across U variants
if_train_improves_but_held_out_actor_rel: stop the current training path without adding epochs or capacity
audit actor target semantics and same-view representation by component and event
expand independent actor/view coverage only where the audit identifies missing support
if_route_retention_or_background_control: repair component sharing or normalization on CPU before any new GPU authorization
parallel_safe_work: inventory existing held-out native and sensor-family assets for a Stage-1 external-validity protocol
complete formal event-bank lineage and immutable human review without reading locked-test model outcomes

not_the_immediate_gap: a larger trajectory decoder or diffusion replacement
a generic increase in route count without actor/component-view support
claim_boundary: A repository-state research-priority audit. It records which missing evidence is scientifically primary and which technical result should be observed next; it is not a model result, dataset release, uncertainty validation, language result, planning result or safety result.
